questions.question: In The Aristocats, what is the name of the butler who stands to inherit everything?
In The Aristocats, what is the full name of the butler villain?

decision: Both request the identity of The Aristocats butler Edgar; the retained surname question requests the more specific name. q82’s inheritance premise also needs the cats-first condition. Retiring avoids retaining the less precise question.

evidence.locator: Opening synopsis identifies Edgar and the inheritance left to Madame Bonfamille’s cats; this source does not establish the surname in q328.
